results.title: Putin hosts African leaders as Russia seeks to deepen ties
results.snippet:
In the Sahel, junta-led Niger, Mali, and Burkina Faso severed Western ties, replacing the Wagner group with the Russian Defense Ministry's Africa Corps, which helped Niger's junta defeat an August troop mutiny in its capital. Between 1,700 and 2,000 Russian mercenaries operate across the three Sahel nations, alongside roughly 1,000 contractors in the Central African Republic.
